## Runs 6–7 — `sdh-spot-check` at D = 0: electron n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6, 0 → 10 T, 10 mT) and hole n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7, 10 → 0.3 T, 20 mT)

Raw first (top row), then 1/B and the 1/B FFT. **Run 6 (electron):** a clean quantum-Hall trace — Rxx zeros (< 5 Ω on a 5 kΩ full scale, noise 2.8 Ω rms) at 1.85, 1.99, 2.31, 2.45, 2.71, 3.24, 3.72, 4.30, 5.91, 6.08 and 7.15 T; SdH visible from ≈ 1.3–1.6 T; a broad 500 Ω maximum at 8.6–9.0 T falling to 300 Ω at 9.75 T; T_sample 1.17 → 1.29 K over the ramp (eddy heating, tolerated). **The zero sequence is not periodic in 1/B**: consecutive spacings run 0.027–0.066 T⁻¹ and three zeros come as close pairs (1.85/1.99, 2.31/2.45, 5.91/6.08 T), so no single 4-fold Landau ladder at any single density reproduces it. FFT: fundamental 7.1 T with peaks at 15.9 / 22.9 / 30.0 T (2 T resolution) — either the harmonic ladder of a very non-sinusoidal 7.1 T tone, or a light Fermi surface at ~7 T plus a heavy one at ~30 T (the calibration's ABAB estimate was 7.5 / 25.6 T; 7 + 30 = 37 T vs F_L = 33 T → density scale ≤ 12 % low, i.e. inside the geometry-prior error). Harmonic-vs-second-band is undecidable from one column. **Run 7 (hole):** shallower oscillations (zeros only at 1.68 / 2.04 T; R ≥ 30 Ω above 3 T), tones at 5.3–6.6 T and **12.3 T = F_L(g = 4) for n = 1.2×10¹² to 1 %**, plus 8.5 T; R climbs to 587 Ω at 10 T (near-CNP high-B upturn). **Take:** the device is in the QH regime from ≈ 2 T on both sides; the run-5 density scale is confirmed to ≲ 12 % (12.3 T tone, 7 + 30 T sum); 50 µV never railed (max fs 0.12), the CNP itself was not crossed at field. The two cuts do **not** make a stacking call — they tell us the fan is feasible and what it must separate: per-row (fixed-B) ν-spacing and gap-closing crossings, per-column F(n) tones (a harmonic stays at exactly k×F for every n; a second band does not).

"""sdh-spot-check read on runs 6 (electron, n=+3.2e12) and 7 (hole, n=-1.2e12), D = 0 (run-5 cal): raw R(B), noise,
Rxx-zero list vs 1/B, sdh_onset tone table, 1/B FFT against F_L = n h/(4e)."""
from scipy.signal import find_peaks, savgol_filter
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
spots = {6: dict(n=3.2, side="electron"), 7: dict(n=-1.2, side="hole")}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
for j, (rid, info) in enumerate(spots.items()):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    Rs = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I; T = r.col("T_sample")
    o = np.argsort(B); B, Rs, T, I = B[o], Rs[o], T[o], I[o]; R = np.abs(Rs)
    sens = r.meta["instruments"]["sr1"]["sensitivity"]
    lo = (B > 0.3) & (B < 1.5); noise = np.std(Rs[lo] - savgol_filter(Rs[lo], 11, 3))
    F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(info["n"] * 1e16))
    print(f"=== run {rid} ({info['side']}, n = {info['n']:+.2f}e12, D = 0): {len(B)} pts, B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, "
          f"T {T.min():.3f}-{T.max():.3f} K, I {I.min()*1e9:.2f}-{I.max()*1e9:.2f} nA, sr1 sens {sens*1e6:.0f} uV (FS {sens/10e-9/1e3:.0f} kOhm), max fs {R.max()/(sens/10e-9):.2f}")
    print(f"  R(0.3 T) = {R[np.argmin(abs(B-0.3))]:.0f} Ohm, R max {R.max():.0f} at {B[np.argmax(R)]:.2f} T, noise (0.3-1.5 T) {noise:.1f} Ohm rms; F_L(g=4) = {F_L:.1f} T, n h/e = {4*F_L:.1f} T")
    sm = savgol_filter(R, 7, 2); sel = B > 1.5
    mins, _ = find_peaks(-sm[sel], prominence=8); Bm, Rm = B[sel][mins], sm[sel][mins]
    deep = Rm < 10
    print("  Rxx minima > 1.5 T (B [T], R [Ohm], 1/B [1/T], nu if n = n_cal): " +
          "; ".join(f"{b:.2f}/{rm:.0f}/{1/b:.3f}/{4*F_L/b:.1f}" for b, rm in zip(Bm, Rm)))
    print(f"  deep zeros (R<10): {np.round(Bm[deep], 2).tolist()} T; consecutive d(1/B): {np.round(-np.diff(1/Bm[deep]), 4).tolist()} (single 4-fold ladder would be {1/F_L:.4f})")
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.3, r_full_scale=sens / 10e-9); print(on.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print("  sdh_onset:", e)
    for (b0, b1) in [(1.5, 10.0), (2.0, 6.0)]:
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(b0, b1), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5, log=False); sp = sp[0]; m = f > 2
        pk, _ = find_peaks(sp[m], prominence=0.1 * sp[m].max()); top = sorted(zip(sp[m][pk], f[m][pk]), reverse=True)[:6]
        print(f"  FFT {b0}-{b1} T: F [T] (rel amp) = " + ", ".join(f"{ff:.1f} ({a/top[0][0]:.2f})" for a, ff in top))
    f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(1.5, 10.0), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5, log=False); sp = sp[0]
    ax = axes[0, j]; ax.plot(B, Rs, lw=0.7); ax.axhline(0, color="k", lw=0.5)
    for b in Bm[deep]: ax.axvline(b, color="r", lw=0.4, alpha=0.6)
    ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("Rxx signed (Ohm)"); ax.set_title(f"run {rid} {info['side']} n = {info['n']:+.1f}e12, D = 0 — raw R(B); red = zeros")
    ax = axes[1, j]; s1 = B > 1.0; ax.plot(1 / B[s1], R[s1], lw=0.7); ax.set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax.set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)"); ax.set_title("vs 1/B (B > 1 T)")
    ax = axes[2, j]; ax.plot(f, sp / sp[f > 2].max()); ax.set_xlim(0, 100); ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("FFT |R| 1.5-10 T (norm)")
    ax.axvline(F_L, color="g", ls="--", label=f"F_L(g=4) = {F_L:.1f} T"); ax.axvline(2 * F_L, color="g", ls=":", label="2 F_L"); ax.legend()
    ax.set_title("SdH FFT in 1/B, 1.5-10 T, deg-5 B-space background")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), B 1 → 10 T × n −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² (auto, E1)

> **05:28** · landau-fan D=0: B slow 1.0->10 T (50 mT to 3 T, 100 mT above; 111 rows) x n fast -1.25->+3.25e12 (141 pts, co-swept Vtg -0.291->+0.998 / Vbg -0.484->+1.185 V), fast\_delay 1 s, sr1 100 uV; ends at 10 T, gates 0 · **ETA ~12:28** (≈7h)

Plan step 4 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`) — the operator's ask. Runs 6/7 (ana) put the device in the quantum-Hall regime from ≈ 2 T, with an **aperiodic** Rxx-zero sequence at n = +3.2×10¹² (paired zeros 5.91/6.08, 2.31/2.45 T; FFT 7.1 T + 16/23/30 T) that one fixed-n column cannot decide between a harmonic ladder and a second Fermi surface. The fan decides it: **per row** (fixed B) the Rxx minima sit on ν-lines n = ν e B/h converging on the CNP, so every gap gets its ν — ABCA: a 16-fold zero-energy LL then a single 4-fold ladder with monotonic gaps; ABAB: two ladders whose gaps close along level-crossing lines; ABCB: a gapped CNP at every B. **Per column**, `sdh_fft` gives F(n) per tone (a harmonic stays at k×F for every n; a second band has its own slope). The ν-line slopes also close the lever-arm check (density scale currently good to ≲ 12 %), and the series-mosaic region B appears as a second CNP at n_A = −0.43×10¹².

**Geometry.** Fast axis = the calibrated D = 0 line (run-5 cal: ratio 0.773, n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm), n = −1.25 … +3.25×10¹² in 141 co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) steps — Δn = 3.2×10¹⁰: 6 pts per 4-fold LL at 2 T, 15 at 5 T, 30 at 10 T; V_tg −0.291 → +0.998 V, V_bg −0.484 → +1.185 V, inside the validators on both ends. Slow axis B ascending from the parked magnet: 1.0 → 3.0 T at 50 mT (onset / light-tone region, 40 rows), then 100 mT to 10 T (71 rows) — 111 rows. **Coverage trade:** the D = 0 line is TG-limited to this n window (the hole side stops at −1.28×10¹²; the box, not a choice); B < 1 T is dropped — run 6 is flat at ≈ 10 Ω there with no SdH below ≈ 1.3 T — 10 rows / 30 min saved. **Dwell:** fast_delay 1 s at the operator's τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, as run 5 (a ≈ 1-step lag along n, uniform for every feature: both ladders shift equally, ν-line intercepts move ≤ 3×10¹⁰; 2 s would cost 3 more hours); slow_delay 3 s after each flyback. **Sensitivity** 100 µV = 10 kΩ full scale: the D = 0 CNP at high B may still rail (that is itself a read — an insulating ν = 0), everything else (runs 6/7 max 590 Ω) sits at ≤ 6 % FS, and run 5 read 50–60 Ω cleanly at this scale. Leak guard > 1 nA on either gate interrupts. Ends at **10 T with the gates at 0** — the next step rides the magnet down.

**Price:** 141 pts × 1.172 s (run 5: same fast_delay, incl. turnarounds) + 6 s/row → 171 s × 111 rows = 5.3 h, plus the 9 T ramp (66 min) and 0 → 1 T (7 min) ≈ 6.5 h; headline 7 h with the session's ≈ 7 % overrun. **Checkpoints** (`hera-watch --follow`): rows 1–2 — sr1 alive and not railed, gate currents at the pA floor, T_sample < 1.5 K, field readback tracking; ≈ 3 T (row 41) — re-form the partial fan: ν-lines converging on n ≈ 0, else abort and re-derive D_offset; ≈ 6 T (row 71) — interim ν assignment + per-column FFT (continue / adjust); completion — full read in ana.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): B slow 1.0 -> 10 T x n fast -1.25 -> +3.25e12, co-swept (Vtg, Vbg) along the calibrated D = 0 line ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)   # run-5 cnp-and-dline-calibration (ana)
# --- preconditions (state this cell assumes but does not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05: parked at 0 after the handoff), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"V_tg = {k_tg.volt():+.3f}, V_bg = {k_bg.volt():+.3f} V (0, 0), nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0, "a heater range is on"
# --- fast axis: n along the calibrated D = 0 line, inside the validators on both ends (TG-limited window is -1.28 .. +3.26e12)
N_FAST = 141
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.25, N_FAST)                       # 1e12 cm^-2, dn = 0.032e12
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros(N_FAST), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs, float), np.asarray(Vbgs, float)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
_nchk, _Dchk = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.allclose(_nchk, n_vec) and np.abs(_Dchk).max() < 1e-6, "D = 0 line round-trip failed"
# --- slow axis: uniform-B rows ascending from the parked magnet: 50 mT to 3 T (onset / light-tone region), 100 mT above
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(1.0, 3.0, 0.05), np.arange(3.0, 10.0001, 0.1))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)   # 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA: headroom for the D = 0 CNP ridge at high B; runs 6/7 peaked at 590 Ohm (<= 6 % FS)
print(f"fast: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 ({N_FAST} pts, dn {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.4f}e12), Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V")
print(f"slow: B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {len(B_vec)} rows ({np.sum(B_vec < 3.0)} at 50 mT, {np.sum(B_vec >= 3.0)} at 100 mT); "
      f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")
mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D = 0: B slow {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_vec)} rows), n fast {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 ({N_FAST}) "
                  f"co-swept Vtg/Vbg on the run-5 D = 0 line, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, sr1 100 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 (run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e} F/m2, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm); '
              f'slow B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, 0.05 T to 3 T then 0.1 T ({len(B_vec)} rows); '
              f'fast n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 ({N_FAST} pts, dn {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.4f}e12) = (Vtg, Vbg) ({Vtgs[0]:+.4f}, {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}) -> ({Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f}); '
              f'fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s; Vsi = 0; sr1 100 uV (10 kOhm FS); T_sample {_T0:.3f} K at start')
# gates to the first fast point before the field moves, so the first row starts settled
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(5)
# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B = {float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg = {float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg = {float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg| = {i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg| = {i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())
try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    # gates back to 0 (cheap); the field stays where the sweep left it (10 T if complete) — the next step rides it down, never re-traverses
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")

# === SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0 (region-A calibration), B 0 -> 10 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
